parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The number of the returned page. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. The maximum value is **50**. Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the BGP group.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vpc describe-bgp-networks --router-id vbr-bp1ctxy813985gkuk0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --region cn-hangzhou
